title: Reading Between the Layers: Cross-Modal Alignment and Representational Hierarchy in Vision Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.32463v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While large vision-language models excel at optical character recognition, it remains unclear how their underlying vision encoders process text and its meaning, and whether they support anything resembling reading comprehension. We systematically study transformer-based vision encoders, using cross-modal alignment between rendered text and visual concepts together with probing and retrieval-based analyses as a controlled window into these broader capabilities. Our layer-wise analyses span orthographic, grammatical, and semantic organization, and reveal that strong cross-modal mapping emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal object and text recognition have already developed, coinciding with a progression from surface-level to semantic representations. translated_title: 解读层间信息：视觉Transformer中的跨模态对齐与表征层级
translated_abstract: 尽管大型视觉-语言模型在光学字符识别方面表现出色，但其底层视觉编码器如何处理文字及其含义，以及它们是否支持类似阅读理解的能力，仍不清楚。我们系统地研究了基于Transformer的视觉编码器，将渲染文本与视觉概念之间的跨模态对齐，连同探测和基于检索的分析，作为考察这些更广泛能力的受控窗口。我们的逐层分析涵盖正字法、语法和语义组织，揭示出强大的跨模态映射仅在最深层中出现，且是在单模态物体和文本识别已经发展之后才形成，这与从表层表征到语义表征的演进过程相吻合。尽管这种层级结构在对比训练的模型中最为显著，但更大的自监督模型和富含文本的训练数据在没有显式对齐（的情况下也能部分支持类似行为）……
tldr: 该研究通过逐层探测与跨模态对齐分析，首次系统揭示视觉Transformer中强大的跨模态语义映射仅在最深层出现，并呈现出从表层识别到语义理解的结构化表征层级。
en_tdlr: The study systematically reveals that strong cross-modal semantic alignment in vision transformers emerges only in the deepest layers, following a hierarchical progression from surface-level to semantic representations.
